contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLOR IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of Trier mint, 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXERC ITVS. In exergue: [T]R.S. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 2.06gms, die axis: 12
